name: Hamura Shou
source:
He transferred to the Yuusei Academy as a sports scholarship student, but his academic performance is poor. He has a twin brother called Kai, who doesn't recognize him.

Shou spent part of his life in an orphanage and was adopted when he was five years old, but unfortunately his adoptive parents also passed away in an accident. Despite this tragedy of losing his adoptive parents, he wields the personality as a strong, courageous, happy and friendly boy.
